evidence: Ellipsometry and van der Pauw measurements confirmed that the crystalline films have optical and electrical properties close to bulk gallium oxide. Out-of-plane coupled 1D XRD scans were performed using a Rigaku Ultima-IV diffractometer... XRD2 scans were performed using a Bruker D8 Discover diffractometer... Surface morphology of the films was examined using a Bruker Dimension Edge Atomic Force Microscope... Cross-section TEM samples were prepared by low-energy ion-polishing... Rocking scans that capture the three closely located α-Al2O3 (006), α-Ga2O3 (006) and β-Ga2O3 (4̅02) peaks were performed... The nanoFAB Fabrication and Characterization Facility at the University of Alberta as well as Thermo Fisher Scientific are thanked for their support in TEM sample preparation and imaging.
